options.name: outputEncoding
options.label: Shell Output Encoding
options.description: Encoding for cmd.exe output. 'auto' = system OEM code page (866 on Russian, 437 on English). Or: 'utf-8', '866', '1251'.

tools.name: run_shell_command
tools.description: Execute a shell command on the host system and return its output.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Full command line to execute. Keep it short and avoid interactive programs.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Text encoding of the command output, e.g. 'utf-8', '866', '1251', '65001'. Only set it when the output looks garbled: omitted, the encoding is detected from the bytes, which is right for non-Latin text on any Windows. A Russian console is 866, an English one 437, and a program that prints UTF-8 is detected as UTF-8.
